title: vulpia dertonensis var. broteroi
intro: Vulpia dertonensis var. broteroi, commonly known as a type of fescue grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating wounds and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Vulpia dertonensis var. broteroi include antioxidant and antiseptic actions, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various diseases. However, the exact bioactive constituents responsible for its properties are still being researched, but it is reported to contain various phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins.
